description: This file defines a report generation module for a Scrum sprint burndown chart in an OpenERP/Odoo environment, including classes for PDF rendering and report creation logic.

classes.name: external_pdf
classes.description: Class for rendering PDF output, inherits from render, encapsulates PDF data.

classes.name: report_tasks
classes.description: Main class for generating the sprint burndown report, implements report_int interface.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for external_pdf, initializes with PDF data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Generates the burndown chart PDF for a given sprint, executes SQL queries, processes data, and draws the chart.
